name: 1667-workspace
description: Source workspace for the 1667 terminal writing environment

scripts.build: npm run schema:check && npm run notes:check && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit
scripts.typecheck: npm run schema:check && npm run notes:check && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit
scripts.schema:check: tsx scripts/story-schema.ts --check && tsx scripts/mutation-ledger-schema.ts --check && tsx scripts/settings-v2-schema.ts --check && tsx scripts/settings-v4-schema.ts --check && tsx scripts/settings-v5-schema.ts --check
scripts.schema:write: tsx scripts/story-schema.ts --write && tsx scripts/mutation-ledger-schema.ts --write && tsx scripts/settings-v2-schema.ts --write && tsx scripts/settings-v4-schema.ts --write && tsx scripts/settings-v5-schema.ts --write
